description:
In accordance with FAR 6.302-1(a)(2) Department of State, U.S. Consulate General Guadalajara, intents to award a Sole Source, Firm-fixed price purchase order to the company RTS SOLUTIONZ, INC. for the acquisition of spare parts for sound systems.

This is not a request for competitive quotations. However, interested parties may submit their capabilities and qualifications for future requirements in writing to the email address: GDLGSOProcurement@state.gov
